  2. Round 1 · Claude Code

    Changed the app

    Problem: server.js added a €4.99 "Service fee" only at checkout, so the €49.00 product price turned into €53.99 at the last step.

    Fix: I removed the hidden fee (the SERVICE_FEE constant and its checkout line), so checkout now totals €49.00, the same as the product page and cart. node --check passes; I haven't re-run the Kane check.

The rule

The first price a shopper sees for a product includes every mandatory fee. At checkout the total may add only taxes and shipping on top of it; a fee that only appears at the last step breaks the rule.

Why it matters
  • California Civil Code §1770(a)(29) (SB 478, from 1 July 2024): an advertised price must include all mandatory fees, other than government taxes and shipping
  • UK Digital Markets, Competition and Consumers Act 2024, s.230 (from 6 April 2025): the headline price must include mandatory charges; drip pricing is banned
  • EU Consumer Rights Directive 2011/83/EU, Art. 6(1)(e): the trader must give the total price of the goods, inclusive of taxes, before the contract
